note: Reference photographs for the OP-mode comparison panel. Each file is redistributed under its own licence with attribution; downscaled copies (1280 px for Jalan China, 960 px for the N1-M5 places), otherwise unmodified. Loaded only when the panel is opened. `consulted` lists photographs that informed a place and are not shipped.

images.title: [M5-4] Old Courthouse: the clock tower (1883) on six round columns, lattice windows, balcony, clock, louvred cupola; shingle roofs and verandah columns behind

images.title: [M5-4] Old Courthouse: a courtyard with single-storey ranges under hipped shingle roofs
images.author: Yeo Jiun Tzen
